name: Taku (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Taku city emblem in yellow and white: a yellow stylised flower-like device bearing a white plum blossom.
history: Municipal flag of Taku, a city in Saga Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 1 May 1974; the emblem dates from 5 May 1954.

features.role: Taku city emblem — a yellow stylised flower-like device bearing a white plum blossom
